interfaces.name: die_outline
interfaces.what: the SENSOR DIE, not a package: chip size 5.0950 mm (H) x 4.9300 mm (V) including scribe, unit cell 1.12 um x 1.12 um. The frame is the die centre on its mounting plane. WHAT THIS DESIGN ACTUALLY FITS IS A MODULE, NOT A BARE DIE: the Microduck carries a lens + holder in front of this sensor (part:microduck-m12-lens, part:microduck-m12-lens-holder, both measured off Pollen's meshes) and the module's own outline, connector and ribbon are CANNOT DETERMINE — part:microduck-camera-module says so in its own record. This row gives the one dimension the sensor datasheet does state, so that a module envelope can later be checked against it. `accepts` is EMPTY on purpose: an SMT land joint is connection:solder-smt, which is NOT on this shelf — naming it would dangle, and a dangling ref is a FAIL in bin/triad check, never a warning.
interfaces.source: READ OFF THE VENDOR'S OWN DATASHEET: Sony IMX219PQH5-C 'Features' block, 'Chip size: 5.095 mm (H) x 4.930 mm (V) (w/ Scribe)', PAGE 2 — the copy in this folder (current/datasheet.pdf, sha256 in current/PROVENANCE.json), read 2026-09-02 (lane T)
